description: FIX_MOVE_FOR_SHOT (ships OFF): a unit with ranged weapons making a normal move toward its plan objective, whose move as planned would leave it with no eligible ranged target (11e 04.02 — the engine's own get_eligible_targets), re-aims the same move so an enemy is an eligible target in its Shooting phase. Same position as exam mv06: U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B 2.2" north of obj_center's ruin, U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_A_P2 the only enemy in reach (19" edge to edge), everyone else parked far away; the straight move onto the ruin ends with every sight line cut by the ruin's inner Solid wall or area-medium-35 (13.10 / 13.11) — the engine says so from there and from the start. With tests/bench_profiles/move_for_shot_on.json loaded, clicking the real Suggest (K) button and focusing the squad shows the card's 'How this turn's move was shaped' line '... for a shot next phase: Custodian Guard Alpha is in sight there ...', the action still 'moves toward obj_center', and the planned destinations have the enemy squad as an eligible target (engine). Clearing the profile restores the shipped default: no note, the straight move, no target from it. Reloading restores the spot; executing it through AIPlayer stages and confirms the move, the engine reports the squad on obj_center with an eligible target, the LoS overlay from the squad draws the line to the enemy as targetable, and the Shooting-phase decision shoots it.
